crossReference: Documents and parsers must name this contract as product-seo-catalog/v1. Do not couple repos by temporary worktree or file paths.

p_host.notes: Request host only. Client never supplies tenantId.

rejectToLimitInvalid: JSON string (including numeric text such as "500")
JSON number with a decimal/exponent that is not a digit-only integer
p_limit.postgrest: Single (text, jsonb) signature. Invalid JSON types must return the versioned envelope, never SQLSTATE 22P02.

envelope.status: ok | catalog_empty | catalog_unavailable | tenant_suspended | host_not_resolved | invalid_host | host_not_primary | primary_missing | multiple_primaries | limit_invalid | internal_error
envelope.ok: true only for status ok or catalog_empty
envelope.catalogComplete: true only for status ok or catalog_empty with proven total (returnedCount === totalCount && truncated === false)
envelope.canonicalHost: active primary host when exactly one active primary exists; never inferred by stripping www; never chosen by LIMIT 1; null on unresolved/invalid/limit/internal/primary_missing/multiple_primaries
envelope.storageOrigin: canonical https origin from server GUC app.settings.api_external_url (fallback product_seo.storage_origin); never from the client; JSON null when missing/invalid
envelope.totalCount: exact matching catalog size for ok/catalog_empty; null on fail-closed statuses
envelope.truncated: true iff status is ok and totalCount > effectiveLimit
envelope.catalogFingerprint: sha256: + 64 lowercase hex of canonical jsonb; JSON null when truncated, incomplete, or fail-closed; identical for apex and www; independent of physical row order, jsonb key order, and call timestamp
envelope.products: array of product objects, ordered by productId, length === returnedCount

statuses.ok: Exactly one active primary, gates passed, totalCount > 0. May be truncated.
statuses.catalog_empty: Exactly one active primary, gates passed, totalCount === 0. Not a failure. May be catalogComplete true.
statuses.catalog_unavailable: Tenant resolved and unique primary known, but site module or catalog_enabled is false. No products. catalogComplete false. Not empty catalog.
statuses.tenant_suspended: tenants.status = suspended. No products. catalogComplete false. Not empty catalog.
statuses.host_not_resolved: Normalized host is non-empty but tenant_id_from_host returns null.
statuses.host_not_primary: Exactly one active primary exists, tenant resolved, request host is neither that primary nor its official www alias. Fail-closed. Not empty catalog.
statuses.primary_missing: Tenant resolved and count of active primaries is 0. Fail-closed. No LIMIT 1 fallback.
statuses.multiple_primaries: Tenant resolved and count of active primaries is > 1. Fail-closed. No LIMIT 1 pick.
statuses.limit_invalid: p_limit is explicit JSON null, non-integer, < 1, or not a JSON number. No products.
statuses.internal_error: Unexpected exception. Fail-closed. Does not leak SQLERRM or URLs.

canonicalAuthority.countActivePrimaries: count(*) from tenant_domains where tenant_id = resolved and is_active and is_primary
canonicalAuthority.exactlyOne: continue; resolve the unique primary host without LIMIT 1 as a chooser
canonicalAuthority.wwwAlias: www.{primary} (or primary that is www of the request) remains accepted

images.originSource: Server GUC only: current_setting('app.settings.api_external_url', true), else current_setting('product_seo.storage_origin', true). Never from the client.
images.originMissing: Fail-closed: omit all images, catalogFingerprint still follows completeness rules, diagnostics origin_unconfigured incremented. Do not invent an origin.
acceptOnlyWhenAll: scheme prefix exactly the four characters h-t-t-p-s-:-/-/ in lowercase (https://); mixed-case such as HTTPS:// is not_https
hostname exactly equal to the configured origin host (case-insensitive)
tenant UUID is a complete path segment equal to tenant_id::text
object_path non-empty with no . or .. segments
reject: any query, including cache-busters such as ?v=1
other project refs, punycode lookalikes, suffix hosts
UUID merely contained in the path
HTTPS:// and any non-canonical scheme spelling
never: strip query to convert a signed URL into a public URL
lowercase or otherwise rewrite a mixed-case scheme into https://
include rejected URLs in the envelope or diagnostics
accept another project-ref because the path contains the tenant UUID
images.diagnostics: Aggregated counts and reasons only. Never the URL.
images.arrayOrder: First-seen among images[], then image_main_url, image_thumb_url, image_original_url, after filtering. Duplicate URLs kept once.

fingerprint.whenNull: truncated = true, catalogComplete false, or any fail-closed status. Do not hash the full catalog when truncated.
fingerprint.nullVsAbsent: currency, availability, publicProductCode, visible, and null price are always present as JSON null. description is always a string (possibly empty). variantAttributes and images are always arrays.
fingerprint.numbers: price is to_jsonb(round(price, 2)) (PostgreSQL numeric JSON number) or JSON null. No other numeric fields in the canonical object.
fingerprint.variantAttributesOrder: material then dimensions, each included only when non-empty after trim. Not sorted alphabetically. Empty values omitted (array may be shorter than 2).
fingerprint.imagesArrayOrder: accepted URLs in first-seen order after structural filter; duplicates dropped.
fingerprint.changesWhen: Any included SEO field of any matching product in the hashed page changes, or tenantId/canonicalHost identity changes. Truncated catalogs do not hash.
doesNotChangeWhen: physical heap/index order of product rows

cost.totalCount: SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE tenant_id = :tenant. Indexable (tenant_id, id). May still walk the tenant index.
cost.heavyWork: SELECT/JOIN/image classify/jsonb_agg only for ORDER BY id LIMIT effectiveLimit rows.
cost.truncatedFingerprint: null; the truncated page is not hashed as if it were the full catalog.
cost.documentation: Count still traverses the tenant index. Payload, image classification, and fingerprint stay bounded by effectiveLimit.

security.rlsBypass: SECURITY DEFINER owned by postgres bypasses RLS on products and related tables. L1A remains: anon cannot SELECT catalog tables via PostgREST. This RPC is the public read path.
security.limitBeforeHeavyAggregation: p_limit is validated and clamped before product aggregation. jsonb_agg of the payload is LIMIT effectiveLimit. totalCount is a separate count(*). Fingerprint runs only when complete.

consumerParser.fingerprint: ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ required iff catalogComplete; must be JSON null when truncated or fail-closed
refuseDoNotRepair: product tenantId missing, null, not a UUID, or divergent from envelope tenantId
product host missing, null, not a host, www alias, or divergent from canonicalHost
required productObject fields missing or wrong type
dangerous prototype keys (__proto__, constructor, prototype) on relevant objects
